findings.conclusion: The generic input names the exact closed dense antilinear involution. The adjoint is maximal, the square uses the actual composition domain, and graph projection gives surjectivity of I+S* S and positive self-adjointness. No self-adjoint extension is inserted as an extra input.

The involution proves a zero kernel for its square; therefore both bounded-resolvent endpoints are injective. Existing resolvent CFC gives imaginary powers with a dense-range damping characterization, group law, inverse and strong continuity.

All five generic proof fields are supplied by the previously constructed concrete GNS closed Tomita operator. The resulting square and resolvent act on that GNS Hilbert space and retain their exact domains.
The instantiated imaginary powers use the same concrete square and inherit its proven damping identity, uniqueness and continuous group laws.

limits: The underlying S is the closure of the original uniform finite-weight star core; equality with the full finite-weight star-core closure is not proved by these four modules.
These proofs do not identify the constructed imaginary powers with conjugation by the regular translation unitaries.
The exp(-s)-scaled trace and remaining PF/core interface fields are not supplied by this delivery.
No production installation, full-program execution or gate change follows from this source review.
